name: iemoeo_s3_confirmation_v1
description: Independent same-budget confirmation after the full development factorial; candidate uses SBX, not certified extrema.

no_combination.label: Combination allowance redirected to local search

contrasts.claim: Local mating isolation with direction-best representatives and SBX
Direction-best versus random representatives with isolation and SBX
Persistent memory at fixed isolation, best representatives, SBX and elite protection
Elite protection with isolation, best representatives, SBX and memory
Whole blocks versus SBX when memory is enabled
Whole blocks versus SBX when memory is disabled
Cross-direction SBX allocation versus continued local search at equal total FE
Independent performance comparison; multi-change, not single-factor attribution

interpretation.I: Closed mating during synchronized local phase; memory/global exchange only between phases, not eternally isolated ancestry.
interpretation.P: Best versus random representative under a fixed direction/normalization, not mathematical extremum.
interpretation.C: Explicit whole-block inheritance versus SBX with equal requested new-evaluation quota.
interpretation.M: Persistent direction memory versus rebuilding identical-capacity pools from current N each batch.
interpretation.E: Direction elite reservation versus same NSGA3 selection without reservation.
interpretation.K: I/P/C all on versus all off; this package effect is not any individual factor.
interpretation.Q: Coordinate-neighborhood finite test only; untested/failed parents forbidden in checked arm, no unqualified fallback; missing combination allowance goes to local search.

confirmation_policy.development_data: All 37 pilot arms, seeds1-5, were inspected before selecting this candidate. Their best observed rank is not unbiased confirmation.
confirmation_policy.seeds: 61-90; must remain uninspected until the complete registered batch is finished.
confirmation_policy.budget: 200N, matching the development comparison. This new registration supersedes the old 400N proposal only for this new confirmation suite.
confirmation_policy.decision: Freeze the candidate and all 18 scenes. Report all contrasts and negative scenes. Do not choose a different candidate from confirmation results.
confirmation_policy.scope: Local isolation, direction-best selection and generic cross-direction recombination. No claim that whole-block inheritance or certified extrema are necessary.
confirmation_policy.statistics: Holm across all 8 contrasts x18 scenes x2 metrics (288 tests). Registered blocks-memory interactions form a separate 18-test family.
